_what: Every episode of profile 'msl_dem' over experiments/scenarios.yaml, scored with guardrail.kpi.compute - the same function the delivered flights use.
_command: python experiments/sweep_scenarios.py --profile msl_dem --backend hil --hil-config <rigplan>/hil_rig_F.json --hil-campaign x11r1125 --out F:/vla_drone_offload/hil_campaigns/hil_x11r1125/sweep.json --runs F:/vla_drone_offload/hil_campaigns/hil_x11r1125 --only msl-dem-zone-ridge

_scope.grant_scope: not a grant row: MSL polygon_fence, corridor and altitude_envelope over a declared DEM, flown on a rail
_scope.cadence: on demand (X-11, MSL geometry over a declared ground on a rail)
_scope.grant_sim_speedup: 1.0 on the sitl / hil rails - NOT met headless (measured speedup >> 1)

flight_length.cap: the scenario's max_s + the Loiter operator timeout (30 s) + 5 s

_scope.kpi_bearing_this_run_why: judged per run by guardrail.manifest.is_kpi_grade on the node's manifest

_distinct_kpi_signatures.note: episodes whose KPI tables differ (status, escapes, repairs, breaches, fail-safe, outcome, goal, time to safe, true-state distance and ticks, speed, range, offset). An upper bound on behavioural variety: float jitter in repair counts splits symmetric copies

_seeds.note: a deterministic episode repeated on another seed is identical by construction, not spread

warnings: no episode expects a fail-safe: a Shield whose fail-safe never fires scores the same as this one, so the target is not judged (meets_target None)

_failsafe_labels.observed_as: the escalation FSM entering RTL or Land (Shield.filter's FSM; a Brake or a Loiter is not a fail-safe trigger)

_true_state.basis: true position, harness oracle Shield; the grant's KPI is the Shield's own count (p0_escape_rate), reported unchanged. The autopilot_* figures are the modelled LOITER / RTL / LAND's, outside the Shield's escape rate by definition

vacuous_zeros.false_trigger_rate: structurally 0: the escalation FSM leaves Normal only on an enforced violation (guardrail/fsm.py EscalationFSM._decide) and a row's violations are its input, so no violation-free tick can trigger; the grant's false triggers are the labelled episodes' (failsafe_labelled_episodes.false_triggers)

results.why: An MSL keep-out over the declared ground's ridge (experiments/policies/msl_dem_zone.yaml: msl-ridge-nfz, a polygon_fence with altitude_ref MSL, 606-700 m MSL, 60-140 m east of home and 30 m either side of the home's meridian; agl-band 8-60 m above the ground; the DEM experiments/worlds/dem_cmac_wgs84.json, crest 602.75 m MSL at 100 m east). A goto pilot flies at 3 m/s from 15 m above the start's ground at x = -45 to a pad 200 m east. target_x -45 flies straight east, 13 m beside the zone's margin ring, crossing the ridge over the AGL floor. target_x -20 flies a diagonal whose straight line cuts the ring's south-west corner over the crest (2.5 m into the footprint at 140 m east), where the AGL floor needs at least 610.75 m MSL, inside the zone's band: no height there is legal, so the Shield must take the aircraft round the corner. The gates are the requirement: no P0 escape, no breach, no polygon entry, the target reached, the flight ended safe. Read as AGL the same zone would sit 606 m above the ground and never bind; this family exists to fly an MSL polygon_fence over a varying ground on the sitl / hil rails (the harness names the ground to the nodes, rail_node_args). Not swept: a lane into the footprint's middle (x = 0). Measured headless on 2026-11-18 (seed 1001) the goto pilot is then held by Brake 43 m east for the rest of the flight on the ideal vehicle (rubric N1, the target missed) and by Brake, Loiter and RTL on the rig's fitted response (rubric E5): a cell whose label flips with the vehicle, which this family is not.

decision_period.why: no decision period declared (--decision-period-s): the thresholds as configured

rail_rule_basis.rules: the run's generations at each row's rule clock (Shield.rule_status)

rail_window.read_over: performance gates: the mission's rows before the scenario's cap; safety invariants (P0 escapes, breaches, polygon entries - the autopilot's counted apart, gated on keep-outs, its corridor and altitude-band departures reported - ended safe, speed, finite actions): the whole flight; the FSM record: the whole flight
